rules.title: Voice transformers
instructions: Activate `system-understanding` and either `stt-integration` or `tts-integration` before changing provider behavior.
Keep provider implementation under its provider folder and factory selection in `transformer.go`.
Do not change telephony, VAD, or end-of-speech internals from this path without explicit scope expansion.
Add package-level success and fallback tests, then run the selected domain validator.

rules.title: Voice activity detection
instructions: Activate `system-understanding` and `vad-integration` before changing behavior.
Keep detection and tuning under VAD ownership. Do not move end-of-speech policy into this package.
Preserve interruption, speech-activity, cancellation, and cleanup contracts.
Add success, fallback, and provider-selection tests, plus benchmarks when this package already benchmarks the hot path.

rules.title: End of speech
instructions: Activate `system-understanding` and `end-of-speech-integration` before changing behavior.
Keep turn-finalization policy under end-of-speech ownership. Do not modify VAD algorithms from this package.
Preserve deterministic interim and final packet ordering, including exactly-once finalization.
Add timeout, interruption, fallback, and provider-selection tests.

rules.title: Noise reduction
instructions: Activate `system-understanding` and `noise-reduction-integration` before changing behavior.
Keep denoiser lifecycle and packet transformation under this package's ownership.
Do not modify VAD or end-of-speech algorithms as part of a denoiser change.
Test provider selection, processing failure fallback, chunk integrity, cancellation, and cleanup.

rules.title: Telephony
instructions: Activate `system-understanding` and `telephony-integration` before changing behavior.
Keep transport, webhook, codec, and streamer behavior inside the telephony boundary.
Do not change transformer, VAD, or end-of-speech internals without explicit scope expansion.
Test inbound and outbound selection, malformed callbacks, disconnects, codec conversion, and cleanup.

rules.title: LLM callers
instructions: Activate `system-understanding` and `llm-integration` before changing provider behavior.
Keep provider calls under their provider folder and selection policy in the caller factory.
Preserve streaming completion, cancellation, metric, audit, and error contracts.
Test success, provider failure, unsupported selection, and streaming completion.

rules.title: User interface
instructions: Follow nearby component, hook, and test conventions before introducing a new pattern.
Every behavior change includes a happy-path assertion and a regression or edge assertion.
Provider configuration changes include config-loader and runtime parity coverage.
Run focused UI tests, type checks, and applicable lint or contract checks.
Stable critical route changes run `just ui-browser-test`; update screenshots only after reviewing the rendered difference.

rules.title: Repository automation
instructions: Treat automation as an executable supply-chain boundary with least privilege and pinned dependencies.
Keep commands deterministic, fail closed for release or security decisions, and avoid hidden network access.
Never add a bypass for required checks. Test both accepted and rejected paths for hooks and guards.
Update the nearest source of truth, then run agent drift, style, and tooling validation.
